## 일일 전쟁사

- **1011** — Danes capture Canterbury after a siege, taking Ælfheah, archbishop of Canterbury, as a prisoner. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Canterbury))
- **1267** — The Treaty of Montgomery recognises Llywelyn ap Gruffudd as Prince of Wales, but only as a vassal of King Henry III. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Treaty_of_Montgomery))
- **1364** — During the Hundred Years' War, Anglo-Breton forces defeat the Franco-Breton army in Brittany, ending the War of the Breton Succession. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hundred_Years'_War))
- **1567** — During the French War of Religion, Protestant coup officials in Nîmes massacre Catholic priests in an event now known as the Michelade. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Wars_of_Religion))
- **1789** — The United States Department of War first establishes a regular army with a strength of several hundred men. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States_Department_of_War))
- **1848** — The Battle of Pákozd is a stalemate between Hungarian and Croatian forces and is the first battle of the Hungarian Revolution. ([wiki](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_P%C3%A1kozd))
